messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "adult and pediatric patients"
set: ["adult and pediatric patients", "adult patients", "edema due to renal disease including nephrotic syndrome in adult and pediatric patients", "adults and pediatric patients with type 1 diabetes", "pediatric patients 12 years and older with depression", "for ADHD in pediatric patients", "pediatric patients with type 2 diabetes", "pediatric patients less than 6 years old", "for adults and pediatric patients (10 years and older) with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia", "LDL-C in adults and pediatric patients (10 years and older) with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage for pediatric patients", "final adult height", "pediatric patients younger than 6 years with type 1 diabetes", "pediatric patients with glomerular filtration rate less than 30 mL/min", "pediatric patients greater than or equal to 6 years of age", "healthcare provider or adult caregiver"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
